import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I’ll inspect the code paths behind digest capping, wait-check floods, file-hook success toasts, and log rotation while the disk/doctor command finishes.

TAGS skip swarm drafts, so I’ll render the digest-pipeline figure and then write the report.

The figure rendered cleanly. I’ll write the full audit report next to it.

The audit is in `research:202611/sase_notifications_and_error_logs_audit__grk.md`. Snapshot id `file:explicit:df38a4abdc38a7dda3b48393`.

**The firehose is the error-digest pipeline.** `recent_errors.json` keeps the last 100 rows with no signature rollup. `agent_publication` 120s-timeout / 1s-cleanup failures refill that ring, so the hourly digest says “100 error(s) in the last hour” (89 such rows on apollo) and other failures drop off. All-time apollo digest lines: 10,128 publication vs 18,818 total.

**Inbox on both hosts is the same three piles:** unread `TaskTriage` beads (486 on apollo, already muted by `quiet-task-beads`), AXE `ViewErrorReport`s, and either research-highlights success toasts (210/212 file-hooks on apollo) or “wait can never self-resolve” (412 on athena, one waiter plus-oned 1,003 times).

**Disk is a real operational risk on apollo.** Nov 16 ENOSPC crash-looped lumberjacks. `sase disk list` still names only ~7.5 GiB of 179 GiB used, so 101 `disk_pressure` rows lead with “unattributed 150–193 GiB.” Athena is 68% full but holds 1.2 GiB `tools/logs` (489 MiB older than 30 days vs a 14-day horizon), 1.7 GiB chats, and a 222 MiB leftover sqlite `.bak`.

Ranked fixes in the report, top four: (1) aggregate the error ring/digest by signature, (2) stop treating parked publication as a fresh hard error every ~15s, (3) close the disk-inventory gap and dedup pressure alerts, (4) apply advertised log/retention horizons and delete known leftovers.
